more_info.overview: Polyoxyethylene (8) stearate is a mixture of mono- and diesters of stearic acid with polyoxyethylene diols, together with unreacted polyol. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-25 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1973). The limit covers polyoxyethylene (8) and (40) stearates together.
